A.name: Dependence/whiteness
A.principle: H-centered aggregate short/long lag-correlation departures; nonlinear joint statistics rather than raw lag subset changes

B.name: Robust direction asymmetry
B.principle: Keep lower/upper branches separately and preserve direction; no repeat of NEXT3 piecewise mapping followed by global recentering

C.name: Distribution change
C.principle: Fixed residual-space cells and separately retained H masses/divergences, distinct from original rank-uniform chi-square/CvM CDF bank

D.name: Sequential likelihood
D.principle: Bounded discrete likelihood alternatives or hazard recurrence; no nearby age-grid search

E.name: Metric-aligned nested combination
E.principle: Same-time train-only pair differences of honest inner base OOF, distinct from old boosted rank learners and NEXT3 binary-loss gates

F.name: Finite multi-expert combinations
F.principle: Conditional on registered independent expert evidence; frozen small combinations, no dynamic gate or percent-grid

G.name: H-only context
G.principle: Small immutable H summaries; distinguish direct base covariates from nested learned forecast combination

H.name: Compact temporal evidence
H.principle: Small causal state recurrence and train-fold readout; no GRU/LSTM/Transformer

family_contract: Each family exact numeric menu/source/stop rule must be frozen before its first score; named slots may be rejected as duplicates or conditionally skipped, never silently replaced after scoring.
